# Compoxen

> Compoxen is a U.S. designed brand of premium composite fencing made from
> mineral-reinforced polymer composite. Every product carries a 20-year
> warranty, requires zero maintenance, ships in five architect-led colors
> (Harbor Slate, Mesa Taupe, Shadow Forge, Redwood Ember, Cocoa Ridge),
> and is sold and installed through a certified dealer network.
> Compoxen is currently available in Utah, Colorado, Idaho, and California,
> and is launching in Nevada (Sep 2026), Arizona (Oct 2026), and Wyoming
> (Jan 2027).

## Product
- [What is composite fencing](https://compoxen.com/composite-fencing): pillar guide to composite fencing as a category and to Compoxen specifically
- [Specifications](https://compoxen.com/specifications): warranty, fire rating, wind rating, temperature range, fastener system
- [Why Compoxen](https://compoxen.com/why-compoxen): material science behind mineral-reinforced polymer composite
- [Colors](https://compoxen.com/why-compoxen#colors): five architect-led palette options with hex values
